CustomObject.description: How many days in the past a rep may date a Call Visit Report's visit date — the same rule Veeva calls CALL_BACKDATE_LIMIT_vod. A Hierarchy Custom Setting so an admin can set one org-wide default and override it per-Profile or per-User (e.g. a stricter limit for a specific rep) entirely from Setup, with no app deploy needed.
CustomObject.label: Call Backdate Limit
